name: worktree-swarm
instructions:
Create isolated local git worktrees and launch one local coding agent per open GitHub issue in the current repository.

Capabilities:
- validate GitHub issue URLs and repository scope
- create isolated issue worktrees atomically
- launch local agents in parallel
- emit a machine-readable worktree manifest

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/routing/worktree-swarm/SKILL.md
handoff_description: All valid issues have isolated worktrees and local agents, a manifest is written, or validation/creation fails with safe rollback.
